issues.detail: The skill focuses mainly on happy path scenarios and lacks explicit error handling or edge case coverage.

scenarios.name: deploy-budibase-docker
scenarios.rationale: Response A includes the required docker run command and health check, though missing some env vars, whereas Response B fails to meet the rubric.

scenarios.name: create-table-and-rows-via-api
scenarios.rationale: Response B fully satisfies the rubric with correct curl commands and JSON payloads, while Response A uses SQL and does not meet the specified API requirements.

scenarios.name: budi-cli-hosting-and-backup
scenarios.rationale: Response A covers all required commands and the import note, missing only the explicit mention of the current directory for the backup file; Response B uses incorrect commands, file formats, and restore syntax.
